channel.title: KnightZ: The Failing Light | Dev Log
channel.description: Daily development updates on KnightZ: The Failing Light by KSUIE_Gaming.

item.title: Dev Log #24: A female base body and a heavier grip
item.description: A new healthy female base body is built, reduced to 25,000 triangles, rigged and textured, with four levels of detail and the shared neck seam. The large male body now holds swords, axes, spears and shields on its own sockets, and a see-through ring on two sword pommels is fixed.

item.title: Dev Log #23: Firelight, earthworks and the first trees
item.description: The manor buildings are furnished and lit, with flickering fires and doors that open. The palisade sits on a bank and ditch with a walkway, the first oak, ash and alder trees are planted, the rivers have flowing water and the hub streams by distance.

item.title: Dev Log #22: A village from kit pieces
item.description: Buildings now come from shared kit pieces on one grid: timber and daub, palisade, build stages and reused Roman stone. Sixteen buildings are in Unreal as level instances, with weathered, snow, burned, charred and rotten states.

item.title: Dev Log #21: Arms that carry their weight
item.description: A full arm pass on every movement clip: fists, free wrists, square shoulders, leg-driven arm swing and a carried bow. The approved set is now in the game with walk and run, a guard walk on right mouse, and hidden dismemberment seams.

item.title: Dev Log #20: From motion library to fighting stance
item.description: All 883 generated clips retargeted into Unreal, put back on the ground and reviewed in a new editor level, with a sword and shield guard, one-cycle loops and a first pass over every weapon set.

item.title: Dev Log #19: A motion library written in plain English
item.description: 865 combat and movement animations for the player, allies, four undead bodies and brigands, generated locally from plain-English descriptions and audited clip by clip.

item.title: Dev Log #18: Combat prototype, real terrain and hair level of detail
item.description: A first playable combat system in C++, ten regions rebuilt from real elevation and river data, and hair level of detail for 15 heroes imported into Unreal.

item.title: Dev Log #16: Hair caps under review
item.description: Five of fifteen hair caps approved, new scalp, neck and silhouette rules, and a triangle budget for every cap.

item.title: Dev Log #17: Outfits, cloaks and textured hair for the whole cast
item.description: A shared garment kit, casual and work outfits for 15 characters, physics cloaks, hidden under-layers and a new hair method.

item.title: Dev Log #14: Lighter characters, same faces
item.description: Textured hair and beard shells, reduced bodies and heads, and a typical character cut from about 93,000 to about 45,000 triangles.

item.title: Dev Log #15: Hands, ears, and the review pass
item.description: A wrist texture fix on both male bodies, new hair rules around the ears, and a ten-step review checklist for every hero.

item.title: Dev Log #12: Every head is Unreal-ready, Geraint and Custennin, eyelashes, and a live link to the editor
item.description: Eight heads packaged for Unreal Engine, Geraint complete, Custennin's face widened, eyelashes on every head, an armpit fix on the standard body, and Unreal connected to Claude.

item.title: Dev Log #13: Seven new faces, and nine characters standing in Unreal
item.description: Seven more heads built overnight, and nine characters running the unarmed animation set in Unreal on skeletons rebuilt to match the mannequin.

item.title: Dev Log #11: Cynan complete, Einion Goch's head, and shared rules for every head
item.description: Cynan finished and bound to the skeleton, Einion Goch's face rig built, and new rules to keep every head interchangeable.

item.title: Dev Log #10: The opening cinematic, two more heads, and the full armoury
item.description: The Chronicle opening cinematic, Iddon and Brother Tysilio complete, Cynan in progress, and studio renders of all 31 arms and armour packages.

item.title: Dev Log #9: Bedwyr and Cadoc complete, Owain textured
item.description: Two heads finished with 52 facial shapes each, Owain's face and hair approved, and a new large male body for the smith.

item.title: Dev Log #8: Sir Bedwyr
item.description: The first named character head on the new pipeline: seam fit, expressive topology, skin, long grey hair and beard, and a face rig.

item.title: Dev Log #7: Tools of the manor
item.description: Sickle, billhook, work axe and spade, each in new, worn and mended states, plus a pipeline for swapping heads on shared bodies.

item.title: Dev Log #6: The design set and eleven heightmaps
item.description: The screenplay, character bible, economy design and world plan are written, and every region now has a 16-bit heightmap with terrain masks.

item.title: Dev Log #5: The armoury
item.description: Longsword, battle axe, mace, pike, shortsword, double axe and the Grendel Slayer: eight game-ready weapon assets with collision, sockets and 2K to 4K textures.

item.title: Dev Log #4: Building the hero
item.description: HERO1, the 1.93 m body behind Owain: hands, face shapes, four hairstyles and a skeleton baked to the Unreal bind pose.

item.title: Dev Log #3: The first humans of a hungry manor
item.description: Peasant bodies, layered period clothing, swappable hair and a dynamic dirt, wet and gore material for the folk of the manor.

item.title: Dev Log #2: Undead twins and the Uld woman
item.description: Two methods for making characters: a clean rebuild, and a fast conform that reuses a finished model's topology, UVs and rig.

item.title: Dev Log #1: The first Uld runs in Unreal Engine 5
item.description: Our first character made the full trip from Blender to UE 5.8: rigged, physics-driven hair and clothing, and retargeted animation.
